purpose: Teach: 琉球/盛岡/大宮/八王子/ケンブリッジ/シベリア/サンパウロ/平壌

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが琉球音楽を聴かせて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to share Ryukyuan music with you.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight lift at the opening — inviting him to imagine the moment. Soft, unhurried pace. Voice settles with quiet affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと盛岡冷麺食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I ate Morioka cold noodles today!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Words tumble out with genuine delight — the small pride of sharing something real he did. Quick pace, open vowels. No performance, just pure enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが大宮の鉄道博物館に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's taking you to the Omiya Railway Museum.
lines.style: Tender delivery of good news. Slight pause before the place name — letting the anticipation settle. Warm but reserved, the way she holds quiet joy for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと八王子の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at picture books in Hachioji!
lines.style: Quick, genuine report — the small thrill of something he experienced with his father. Open, unguarded. Slight emphasis on the place name showing he remembers where it was.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがケンブリッジ大学のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to tell you about Cambridge University.
lines.style: Attentive, almost reverent softness. Slow, deliberate pacing — this is something bigger. Voice holds space for wonder. Slight trailing-off, leaving room for him to feel it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、シベリアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at picture books about Siberia today!
lines.style: Eager report with genuine interest shining through. Quick, earnest delivery. The small pride of encountering something larger than himself. Slight breathlessness on the place name.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサンパウロの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you picture books about São Paulo.
lines.style: Gentle announcement with warmth. Soft opening. Slow, measured pace — painting a picture of the reading moment to come. Voice carries quiet anticipation for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、平壌のニュースは難しいけど聞いてみるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I tried listening to news about Pyongyang today, even though it's hard.
lines.style: Quiet, deliberate earnestness. Slight hesitation before admitting the difficulty — he's testing himself, trying something bigger. Slow pace. Trailing-off at the end shows both effort and small pride.
